learner_visible_scene.title: The Usual Place
learner_visible_scene.setup: 친구가 이렇게 말했습니다: "Let's meet at the usual place after work."
learner_visible_scene.ask: 어디에서 만나자는 뜻인지 확인하는 영어 질문을 한 문장으로 해보세요.

required_learner_action: Ask one clarification question before answering.
transfer_test: Can you ask what the other person means?

story_consequence.on_pass: The friend names the meeting place.
story_consequence.on_needs_review: The friend gives a simpler hint and asks you to try again.

claim_boundary: This mission can record local transfer evidence only. Narrative context is not proof of fluency.
